'''Pyromaki''' is a [[Fire]] type [[Tank]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Chefugu]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Ahoy captain! Conquering the deepest seas for the freshest ingredients, Pyromaki has taken the culinary world by storm with the ultimate feast!"

Pyromaki is a rainbow rarity Tatari. Like all Tier 4 evolutions, it requires B Rating to acquire, therefore its feeding level cannot be below B rating for each stat.
